parts.name: Form
parts.description: A native <form> that validates its Fields on submit, focuses the first invalid one, and shows errors passed in.

props.name: validationMode
props.description: When fields validate, unless a FieldRoot says otherwise.

props.name: errors
props.description: Errors to show on fields, keyed by field name. An entry is hidden once its field's value changes, until `errors` changes. Changes are seen by content (an .rx object source keeps its identity when written), so reset it (to {}) when a submit starts: the same errors coming back for the next submit are then a change, and show again.

props.name: onFormSubmit
props.description: Called on a valid submit with the values of the named fields; the native submission is then prevented.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on a valid submit, before `onFormSubmit`.
